question: Lacchu Maharaj was a noted Indian classical dancer and choreographer of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kathak.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lacchu Maharaj was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who is known for his contributions to the field of Kathak.**
 
• He was born in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh,** India, in a family of Kathak dancers and musicians.
 
• Lacchu Maharaj was trained by his father and uncle, both of whom were prominent Kathak dancers themselves.
 
• He was known for his intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive facial expressions, which he incorporated into his performances and choreography.
 
• Some of his notable works include "Krishna Leela," "Kathak Rang", and "Ritu Rang", among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi i**s a classical dance form that originated in the state of Odisha in eastern India. It is known for its **fluid movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial expressions.**
 
• **Chhau** is a tribal dance form that originated in the eastern states of India, particularly in Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha. It is known for its **acrobatic movements, colorful masks, and elaborate costumes.**
 
• **Kuchipudi **is a classical dance form that originated in the state of Andhra Pradesh in southern India. It is known for its **dynamic footwork, graceful movements, and expressive storytelling.**
